knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Dry dusting first means dust is not pushed into damp surfaces, and the wet work removes what settles.
The bathroom is cleaned after the in-room touch surfaces and before the bed is made, so clean linen is not handled after bathroom work.
Soiled linen and rubbish leave the room before any cleaning begins.

practicalCriteria: Works a simulated room in the set order: linen and rubbish removed first, dusting before wet work, bathroom before the bed is made, floor last.
Completes the sequence inside a stated time window without skipping a stage, and notes any stage not completed.
Keeps bathroom cloths and products apart from room cloths for the whole run, as observed by the assessor.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80 percent pass mark (all three correct). Practical criteria are observed and signed off separately by an assessor. A knowledge pass is not practical competence.
evidenceRequired: Job checklist showing stages ticked in order
stopWorkCriteria: Clean linen placed on an unfinished surface
Wet work carried out before dusting in the same area without a recorded reason
